hazard_zones.name: Barak River floodplain
hazard_zones.description: Critical low-lying floodplain along the Barak River susceptible to severe seasonal overflow and road inundation.

hazard_zones.name: Berenga-Betukandi
hazard_zones.description: Historical dyke breach zone at Berenga-Betukandi resulting in rapid urban submersion.

hazard_zones.name: Malugram Drainage Basin
hazard_zones.description: Low-lying residential sector vulnerable to river backflow and drainage congestion.

hazard_zones.name: Dudhpatil Foothill Slopes
hazard_zones.description: Steep unreinforced slopes prone to slope collapse and debris runoff during heavy monsoons.

hazard_zones.name: Hunthar Active Sinking Zone
hazard_zones.description: Major active subsiding zone on NH-54 with continuous ground displacement and slope failure.

hazard_zones.name: Laipuitlang Hillside Slope
hazard_zones.description: Steep shale rock formation area with high rockfall and landslide hazard.

hazard_zones.name: Chite Lui River Channel
hazard_zones.description: Valley bottom stream prone to torrential flash floods and sediment accumulation.

hazard_zones.name: Dikrong River Floodplain
hazard_zones.description: Low-lying floodplain along the Dikrong river north of Itanagar prone to monsoon overflow and inundation of connecting roads.

hazard_zones.name: NH-415 Karsingsa Landslide Corridor
hazard_zones.description: Critical capital lifeline stretch between Banderdewa and Itanagar repeatedly blocked by heavy mudslides at the Karsingsa block point.

hazard_zones.name: Jollang Road Slope
hazard_zones.description: Steep unstable slope along Jollang Road with a history of fatal landslides during heavy monsoon rain.

hazard_zones.name: Poma / Pachin River Intake
hazard_zones.description: River catchment feeding the Poma water intake, where flood surges previously severed the municipal drinking water supply to Itanagar.

hazard_zones.name: Brahmaputra South Bank Floodplain
hazard_zones.description: Riverside stretch spanning Pandu to Bharalumukh exposed to high water levels and riverbank erosion.

hazard_zones.name: Anil Nagar - Nabin Nagar Basin
hazard_zones.description: Severely waterlogged low basin during monsoon downpours with critical urban flooding.

hazard_zones.name: Narakasur Hills Escarpment
hazard_zones.description: Hill cutting and deforested steep slopes creating high landslide risk for foothill settlements.
